##### Project general facts

Aras Heights by Aras Group is a contemporary residential building that combines modern architecture with advanced home technology. Laconic forms and strict geometric lines define the facades, while the building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a rooftop with a swimming pool and relaxation areas. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with carefully planned layouts that enhance everyday convenience and comfort.

Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with a pool deck, an indoor gym and an outdoor fitness area, as well as sports courts and a multi-purpose outdoor zone for an active routine. A children's play area, landscaped lawns, picnic areas, sunken seating and relaxation zones offer calm places to unwind, while shops, cafes and restaurants within the building, covered parking, lifts, an intercom and round-the-clock security add everyday convenience.

Homes feature durable, high-quality finishes and equipped kitchens, while an integrated smart home system allows residents to control lighting and climate remotely and monitor security with ease. Thoughtful layouts make the most of natural light and space, creating functional and elegant interiors. Homes are delivered fully furnished, providing a ready-to-move-in solution for owner-occupiers and investors seeking effortless city living.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a calm residential community in Dubailand, known for its green spaces, modern apartment buildings and family-friendly atmosphere. Landscaped parks, recreational areas and community retail give the neighbourhood a balanced, relaxed character, while supermarkets, clinics and schools cover everyday needs close to home and keep daily life simple for families and professionals, with the green neighbourhoods of Al Barari and Arabian Ranches close by.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road connect residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport. IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, The Park and Dubai Outlet Mall are a short drive away, while Hamdan Sports Complex, Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Academic City are within comfortable reach for work, study and leisure.

Majan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Ready, furnished apartments close to major leisure attractions and highways attract tenants seeking value and convenience. Competitive prices, low vacancy and steady demand from young professionals and families support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
